Since $103$ is larger than $69,$ the answer will be negative.

We start by solving an easier problem:

$$
103-69
$$

Next, we carry out the subtraction:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,0\end{aligned} & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,9\end{aligned} & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,13\end{aligned} \\  &  & \,\,\,1\,\,\, & \,\,\,0\,\,\, & \,\,\,3\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,-\,\,\,\, &  &  & \,\,\,6\,\,\, & \,\,\,9\,\,\, \\  &  &  & \,\,\,3\,\,\, & \,\,\,4\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
103-69=34.
$$

However, since our answer must be negative, we need to change the sign of the answer above. 

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
69-103=-34.
$$
